5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I wondered whether my attempt at changing the Constitution would end any differently than Alphonso's.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Gloria looked at Petr. She looked annoyed.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I looked out the window as the noise of the city diminished, and saw that we were already inside the Palace complex.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: He abruptly turned away from me and walked towards his seat.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: The Maroon Palace stood on a small hilltop surrounded by trees. We passed by the palace and entered the forest that separated it from the Grand National Assembly.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: We drove on the small road that wound through the forest. It was a warm day, so I rolled down the window. I could hear birds singing from the trees.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: The complex housed the buildings of all government branches in the centre of Holsord. It was one of the biggest developments in Sordland.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: The pace in the hall definitely increased. The groups dispersed and MPs began lining up at the ballot box.

16.speaker: Gloria Tory
16.text: "It's looking pretty good. 20 more votes to count."

18.speaker: Petr Vectern
18.text: "What? 50 votes left and we still need 49 more ayes. Shit!"

19.speaker: Player
19.text: "Hey, Serge. I'm okay. How are you doing?"

23.speaker: Serge Wolkner
23.text: "I'm sure it's going to work out fine, sir."

27.speaker: Serge Wolkner
27.text: "I'm as good as I can be, sir."

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: Serge made a left turn out the forest and entered the vast garden area of the Assembly.

32.speaker: Player
32.text: "I hope he doesn't sabotage the vote."

35.speaker: Serge Wolkner
35.text: "Did you know that Mr. Tarquin Soll came to Holsord this morning?"

36.speaker: Serge Wolkner
36.text: "I heard some politicians talking about it today. Apparently this is the first time he's come to the city in the last five years."

37.speaker: Serge Wolkner
37.text: "I thought he left the mainland and lived on Duru Island, never to return to politics. But they were saying he might be here to exercise his Member of Honor rights for the first time..."

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "Wait, what? Who was talking about this?"

42.speaker: Serge Wolkner
42.text: "Yes sir. I overheard several men talking about it around the gardens of the Assembly."

43.speaker: Serge Wolkner
43.text: "I'm sure you'll meet him, sir. If he's coming here after all these years, he would pay the President his respects."

44.speaker: Serge Wolkner
44.text: "Do you think he's here because of today's vote?"

45.speaker: Player
45.text: "Maybe he's here to make a statement."

47.speaker: Player
47.text: "He's here to show everyone he's still alive."

49.speaker: Gloria Tory
49.text: "The proposal will be presented to the Supreme Court shortly for the final voting procedure."

50.speaker: Player
50.text: "He's probably here to make a scene."

51.speaker: Player
51.text: "He's at the back of the hall."

52.speaker: Player
52.text: "I bet it was just some rumor. I don't think he'll appear out of nowhere."

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: He tried to get Gloria's attention by waving at her.

54.speaker: Serge Wolkner
54.text: "Well, I'm sure he will support you, sir."

56.speaker: Serge Wolkner
56.text: "Of course, sir. Good luck with the vote!"

57.speaker: Gloria Tory
57.text: "Thereby, the Grand National Assembly has decisively rejected the changes to the Constitution."

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: Serge drove inside the gates of the parkway and parked the car.

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: They cast their votes and walked away.

77.text: The Assembly was roaring with all kinds of different reactions.

79.text: "Thereby, the Grand National Assembly has rejected the changes to the Constitution."

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: I walked up the white stone stairs of the Grand National Assembly. The entrance looked like a temple gate from the classical era.

86.speaker: Narrator
86.text: I walked down to join him.

87.speaker: Narrator
87.text: The door opened to reveal vast corridors of wood and white stone. I joined the crowd of people who were walking slowly towards the parliamentary hall.

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: Many members of Assembly looked at me with puzzled faces. But at least the USP members seemed to hurry a little faster to the ballot box.

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: Suddenly, I noticed Lucian emerge from the crowd of packed politicians in front of me. He looked relieved when he saw me.

93.speaker: Lucian Galade
93.text: "Ah, sir. There you are. Have you seen Vice President Vectern? He's nowhere to be found."

95.speaker: Player
95.text: "I don't think he'll miss a vote this important..."

96.speaker: Player
96.text: "I'm sure he's among the crowd somewhere."

101.speaker: Narrator
101.text: He pointed at the back of the Assembly, near one of the exits.

102.speaker: Player
102.text: "EVERYBODY! CAST YOUR VOTE AND SIT BACK. DON'T CROWD THE HALL!"

106.speaker: Lucian Galade
106.text: "I hope Mr. Vectern arrives soon too..."

108.speaker: Lucian Galade
108.text: "At any rate, how about yourself? Are you ready to finally face the Assembly, sir?"

109.speaker: Player
109.text: "I can't take this. It must be valuable to you."

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: I looked at the back of the watch. It was made in 1920. I put it in my front pocket and gave my thanks to Serge. I opened the car door.

111.speaker: Player
111.text: "As ready as I've ever been, Lucian."

114.speaker: Narrator
114.text: He put the watch in his front pocket and I opened the car door.

117.speaker: Player
117.text: "Lucian. I've just heard something worrying from Serge..."

118.speaker: Serge Wolkner
118.text: "Yes, sir. You are right. I will hold on to the watch myself."

119.speaker: Lucian Galade
119.text: "We'll address that later, sir. Come, we must go inside."

121.speaker: Lucian Galade
121.text: "I have full confidence in you, Mr. President."

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: He put the watch in his front pocket and I opened the car door.

124.speaker: Lucian Galade
124.text: "Don't be. We'll face the results now."

126.speaker: Narrator
126.text: We followed the crowd into the parliamentary hall. After we were inside, Lucian and I separated to take our assigned seats. I went up to the mezzanine overlooking the hall and sat down.

128.speaker: Narrator
128.text: I looked at the back of the watch. The year 1920 was engraved on it. I put it in my front pocket, gave my thanks to Serge and opened the car door.

129.speaker: Narrator
129.text: He opened his hand and showed me a very old-looking pocket watch. It looked like it was made during the Century of Revolutions.

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: I waited as the MPs took their places inside the hall one by one.

131.speaker: Serge Wolkner
131.text: "Before you go, I want you to take this. My father had this pocket watch, and he said it protected him from the evil of this world. I want you to have it."

132.speaker: Narrator
132.text: After a while, I saw Gloria walk to her elevated seat at the center of the hall.

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: I felt destroyed. I lowered my head and closed my eyes for a second.
133.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Law_MediaBias"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Speech_Democracy_Conservative"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Law_MediaBias"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Speech_Democracy_Conservative"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) == false)

136.speaker: Gloria Tory
136.text: "Please take your seats. We will shortly begin with today's agenda of the USP's proposed changes to the Constitution of Sordland."

138.speaker: Narrator
138.text: After a short while, everybody was in their seats.

140.speaker: Gloria Tory
140.text: "According to the current Constitution, constitutional amendments require a two-thirds majority in order to reach Assembly approval."

141.speaker: Narrator
141.text: He looked at Gloria as she and her assistants counted the votes. The Speaker's seat was only a few meters away from our platform.

142.speaker: Gloria Tory
142.text: "If the vote succeeds, the proposal will be sent to the Supreme Court."

143.speaker: Narrator
143.text: We left the hall together to grab a drink at the Palace.

144.speaker: Gloria Tory
144.text: "The proposal in question includes these points..."

145.speaker: Player
145.text: "THE CONSTITUTION IS AT STAKE! STOP WASTING YOUR TIME!"

146.speaker: Gloria Tory
146.text: "First section of the changes... Article 57 is modified with the following..."

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: She started reading the proposal to the Assembly.

149.speaker: Petr Vectern
149.text: "I mean... Maybe I was not in this exact seat, sure... But I was here in the Assembly."

150.speaker: Narrator
150.text: It felt like an eternity had passed. Finally, she finished reading the changes.

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: She continued reading the proposal, highlighting each section.

152.speaker: Petr Vectern
152.text: "I really hope this proposal goes through..."

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: Most of the MPs seemed like they were already falling asleep.

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: The seat was really hurting my back.

161.speaker: Player
161.text: "No, you were not. I was here until the voting began."

162.speaker: Gloria Tory
162.text: "...I hereby invite all of you to vote."

163.speaker: Petr Vectern
163.text: "You're right, but do you really think the bordello would pick up the phone this early in the day?"

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: After I talked with Petr about the vote, we both left the hall to discuss our next steps.

167.speaker: Player
167.text: "LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! VOTE NOW FOR THE FUTURE OF SORDLAND!"

170.speaker: Petr Vectern
170.text: "I was right here. Where were you?"

174.speaker: Gloria Tory
174.text: "As I previously stated, it will require a two-thirds majority in order to pass..."

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: She struck her gavel down. The loud bang made some MPs jump up in shock as they woke from their deep sleep.

179.speaker: Petr Vectern
179.text: "Speaking of which, how about a celebratory drink?"

180.speaker: Narrator
180.text: I felt the need to stand up and stretch. I looked down at the hall from the platform I was seated on.

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: Some Assembly members immediately walked to the ballot box to cast their votes. Most of them, however, began to congregate in groups around the hall, discussing the changes.

184.speaker: Player_Italic
184.text: Go down to the hall where all the MPs are.

186.speaker: Player_Italic
186.text: Sit back down and keep watching.

187.speaker: Petr Vectern
187.text: "Our best bet to divide the Old Guard votes is Garaci. He's the most corrupt person I've ever known."

189.speaker: Petr Vectern
189.text: "We need 30 out of the last 40. Damn."

192.speaker: Narrator
192.text: My voice echoed in the hall. Everybody turned and looked at me with surprise.

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: Gloria raised an eyebrow when she saw me.

200.speaker: Player
200.text: "I'll talk to the key figures of the Court. We'll be fine."

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: Some USP members started to whistle and clap while others gave me puzzled looks.

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: We waited for Serge by the entrance.

205.speaker: Narrator
205.text: After regathering our thoughts, Petr and I walked out of the Assembly hall.

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: I followed his finger to see Tarquin Soll sitting there.

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: We both went back to our seats. When I returned back to the mezzanine, I saw Petr sitting in the chair next to mine.

210.speaker: Narrator
210.text: Some of the members in the hall started to shout back at me.

211.speaker: Gloria Tory
211.text: "Ladies and Gentlemen of the Assembly! We will soon begin counting. Please cast your votes if you haven't already."

213.speaker: Gloria Tory
213.text: "20 votes left to count. It doesn't look good for you."

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: We both looked down at the floor for a while.

216.speaker: Narrator
216.text: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.

218.speaker: Gloria Tory
218.text: "Now. Why don't you two get back to your seats, as well."

219.speaker: Narrator
219.text: The shouts turned into booing, and the Assembly broke into chaos.

220.speaker: Narrator
220.text: He looked at me with surprise.

222.speaker: Narrator
222.text: Gloria hit the gavel three times.

223.speaker: Petr Vectern
223.text: "Did you hear that? We are screwed...

226.speaker: Gloria Tory
226.text: "Gentlemen! Please! Don't you know how to cast a vote? This is not a circus!"

227.speaker: Narrator
227.text: He walked to his seat with a fist in the air.

228.speaker: Narrator
228.text: Some MPs started shouting back at Gloria.

232.speaker: Narrator
232.text: She kept hitting the gavel frantically.

233.speaker: Player
233.text: "If the USP abandons us, we'll form a new party."

234.speaker: Gloria Tory
234.text: "Ladies and gentlemen! Please have civil conversations and refrain from shouting at each other! If you are not capable of that, please leave the Assembly!"

235.speaker: Narrator
235.text: She banged the gavel several times. The sound echoed across the room.
235.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)

237.speaker: Narrator
237.text: They went ahead and cast their votes.
237.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)

238.speaker: Gloria Tory
238.text: "Also, Mr. President. Please refrain from shouting yourself. If you want to share something with the Assembly, please ask to speak after the vote session is concluded."

239.speaker: Petr Vectern
239.text: "We need to hold an emergency meeting to plan our next moves."

241.speaker: Gloria Tory
241.text: "Thereby, the Grand National Assembly has reached a two-thirds majority and accepted the changes to the Constitution."

242.speaker: Petr Vectern
242.text: "It's hard to be in charge without any support... well, let's see what happens."

243.speaker: Gloria Tory
243.text: "Don't worry. There is already a time limit and we are abiding by the rules. Assembly members are used to this process."

244.speaker: Narrator
244.text: I saw some people cast their votes, but many were still walking around the hall or talking to each other.

246.speaker: Narrator
246.text: Then, I noticed Kesaro Kibener approaching.

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: He stopped below the mezzanine and looked up at me.

249.speaker: Petr Vectern
249.text: "You are right... So you think we can still survive this?"

250.speaker: Player_Italic
250.text: Go down to talk to him.

252.speaker: Lucian Galade
252.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)

253.speaker: Lucian Galade
253.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)) == false

256.speaker: Narrator
256.text: We looked at each other in silence for a few moments. Finally, he spoke.

257.speaker: Narrator
257.text: A single bang from Gloria's gavel reverberated across the hall. Everyone fell silent.

258.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
258.text: "Mr. President! How are you feeling up there? Are you comfortable?"

259.speaker: Player
259.text: "Screw Soll and the party. We were always on our own."

261.speaker: Narrator
261.text: He looked much older than he had five years ago. But I could tell he had the same fire in him. Some MP's had already gathered around him and were chattering in awe.

268.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
268.text: "Keep hoping if you want. You already know our position."

269.speaker: Albin Clavin
269.text: "I'm surprised to see you here, considering the way you ignored your own party. Don't worry, Mr. President. We are here. Relax."
269.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)) == false

270.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
270.text: "You were once sitting among us in the Assembly, working under the Soll administration... Don't ever forget your past."

271.speaker: Petr Vectern
271.text: "Soll or no Soll, we are definitely fucked. Neither the party nor the public is going to be pleased."

272.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
272.text: "You seem to be fond of your position. Try to enjoy it while you can."

276.speaker: Albin Clavin
276.text: "I'm sorry to take so long, Mr. President. There was a *friend* who needed more clarification for his vote."
276.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)

277.speaker: Petr Vectern
277.text: "In any case, the proposal has passed the Assembly. But now we have to think about the Supreme Court..."

278.speaker: Narrator
278.text: Suddenly, I saw Lucian waving at me. He was among a group of people gathered in the hall.

279.speaker: Lucian Galade
279.text: "I doubt that, sir. I think he's here to sabotage the vote by sheer force of personality."

280.speaker: Narrator
280.text: As soon as I reached the bottom of the stairs, Kesaro Kibener approached me.

282.speaker: Lucian Galade
282.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)

283.speaker: Lucian Galade
283.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)) == false

284.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
284.text: "Mr. President! How are you feeling about the vote?"

285.speaker: Player
285.text: "We can't change the Constitution, so what? We are still in charge."

290.speaker: Player
290.text: "Not so fast. We still have the Court to pass."

296.speaker: Narrator
296.text: He turned his back and walked out the exit as two of his guards held the doors for him.

297.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
297.text: "You know I can't do that. We have already stated our decision."

298.speaker: Narrator
298.text: The Assembly gradually went quiet as people started to notice Soll's presence in the hall.

299.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
299.text: "That's the right feeling. This whole proposal is a mistake."

300.speaker: Tarquin Soll
300.text: "Give the title you hold the respect it deserves, Mr. President."

301.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
301.text: "The best outcome for this proposal is failure."

303.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
303.text: "Even knowing you don't have our support? How optimistic of you."

305.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
305.text: "I have lost my respect for you, Mr. Rayne. So many problems in Sordland that must be addressed, and yet you insist on stalling us with your 'democratic' reforms..."

311.speaker: Albin Clavin
311.text: "I'm surprised to see you here, considering the way you ignored your own party. Don't worry, Mr. President. We are here. Relax."
311.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)) == false

312.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
312.text: "I know you will fail. You will lose the game. And so will your entire administration."

317.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
317.text: "I hope to be there when it happens."

318.speaker: Narrator
318.text: He gestured at the men behind him.

320.speaker: Gloria Tory
320.text: "Thereby, the Grand National Assembly has surpassed a two-thirds majority and accepted the changes to the Constitution."

321.speaker: Narrator
321.text: He turned his back and walked out the exit as two of his guards held the doors for him.

326.speaker: Player
326.text: "We have to make sure he doesn't sabotage anything."

327.speaker: Albin Clavin
327.text: "I'm sorry, Mr. President. We had an issue with one vote at the last minute. I've collected them all now."
327.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)

328.speaker: Player_Italic
328.text: Shout at the Assembly from the center of the hall.

330.speaker: Narrator
330.text: Then I saw Lucian waving at me. He was among a group of people in the corner of the hall. I walked up to him.

332.speaker: Narrator
332.text: On my way, I bumped into Mansoun Leke.

333.speaker: Player
333.text: "Former President Soll. Nice of you to join us."

334.speaker: Mansoun Leke
334.text: "Mr. President! I'm sorry, I didn't see you there..."

335.speaker: Frens Ricter
335.text: "It is time to realize that real change will only come from real reformists. The People's Freedom and Justice Party will keep leading this movement!"

336.speaker: Mansoun Leke
336.text: "I wish you good luck with the vote."

337.speaker: Lucian Galade
337.text: "You of all people know the strength of his personality. We must keep the Assembly's attention focused on you and your reforms."

340.speaker: Lucian Galade
340.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_8"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_Independents_1"] == true) == false

344.speaker: Player
344.text: "Just cast your votes and let the counting begin."

345.speaker: Mansoun Leke
345.text: "I respect your fight to decrease the election threshold. The Independents will be giving you our full support."

346.speaker: Player_Italic
346.text: Go and ask Gloria to speed up the voting.

347.speaker: Mansoun Leke
347.text: "If this succeeds, this will finally open the way for Bludish representation in the Assembly. We'll have you to thank for that."

350.speaker: Mansoun Leke
350.text: "I respect your fight to abolish the Member of Honor position. At last, a chance to hold Tarquin Soll accountable for what he did to the Bludish people..."
350.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_8"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_Independents_1"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Abolished"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_Independents_1"] == true)

352.speaker: Lucian Galade
352.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)

353.speaker: Lucian Galade
353.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == false)  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Amendment_USP_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)) == false

354.speaker: Mansoun Leke
354.text: "I'm also 100 percent behind your decision to abolish the Member of Honor position. At last, a chance to hold Tarquin Soll accountable for what he did to the Bludish people..."

359.speaker: Player
359.text: "The faithful and selfless servant of our nation, the distinguished face of our republic, Colonel Tarquin Soll!"

360.speaker: Mansoun Leke
360.text: "You have my support. I'd like to also see you support Bludish rights in the future. I hope you stand by us."

362.speaker: Narrator
362.text: He walked out the exit as two of his guards held the doors for him.

364.speaker: Mansoun Leke
364.text: "Today is a big day for you, after all."
364.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_8"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_Independents_1"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Abolished"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_Independents_1"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_Independents_1"] == true)

365.speaker: Narrator
365.text: He stood and gazed around the hall as all of the members of the Grand National Assembly went silent.

366.speaker: Player
366.text: "It's a big day for all of us."

367.speaker: Narrator
367.text: Suddenly, I noticed Tarquin Soll slowly rising from his seat at the back. He seemed to be struggling, and used his cane for help.

368.speaker: Player
368.text: "I hope I have your support, Mr. Leke."

369.speaker: Player
369.text: "Thanks for all your hard work, Petr!"

370.speaker: Player
370.text: "I need the independents to make it bigger."

372.speaker: Mansoun Leke
372.text: "Most of the independents will be voting yes, Mr. President."

373.speaker: Albin Clavin
373.text: "Good day to you, gentlemen, Madame Speaker..."

374.speaker: Gloria Tory
374.text: "Oh, by the way, we have 251 members today. As you can see, the Member of Honor is here. He has already cast his vote."

375.speaker: Narrator
375.text: Albin Clavin and three other men approached us with envelopes in their hands.

376.speaker: Mansoun Leke
376.text: "Even though we feel it doesn't address the issues we care about the most, it is still a step in the right direction."

377.speaker: Narrator
377.text: Loud applause came from the PFJP seats.

378.speaker: Mansoun Leke
378.text: "But I have to say... we were disappointed when we first read the proposal."

380.speaker: Player
380.text: "Thank you for the nice words. You have my support too."

381.speaker: Frens Ricter
381.text: "I hereby invite the Supreme Court to do the right thing by not ignoring the decision of a Grand National Assembly that was elected by the Sordish people!"

382.speaker: Player
382.text: "I will fight for Bludish rights, Mr. Leke. Don't doubt that."

384.speaker: Player
384.text: "Thank you. But I don't think the Bludish people are facing as many problems as in the past."

385.speaker: Narrator
385.text: The reformist MPs started applauding him.

386.speaker: Mansoun Leke
386.text: "The problems might not be identical, but they are still there, Mr. President. Don't presume to know what the Bludish people are facing."

387.speaker: Lucian Galade
387.text: "Has he, now. So, Mrs. Tory, how many votes are missing?"

388.speaker: Mansoun Leke
388.text: "I hope you stand by your words, Mr. President."

395.speaker: Mansoun Leke
395.text: "Anyway, I've got to go cast my vote."

396.speaker: Frens Ricter
396.text: "His unorthodox methods of persuasion, I'm sure, have been experienced by most of us here. This is a corrupt administration we're dealing with."

397.speaker: Narrator
397.text: Suddenly, Gloria came up behind us.

398.speaker: Narrator
398.text: He shook my hand and walked away.

399.speaker: Lucian Galade
399.text: "I would advise against that right now. The Assembly must focus on the vote. Any confrontation between the two of you would draw their attention away."

401.speaker: Gloria Tory
401.text: "Gentlemen. Why don't you go back to your seats? Let's follow the procedure."

402.speaker: Player
402.text: "We have done our best, Mr. Leke."

403.speaker: Frens Ricter
403.text: "He's just like his predecessors -- enjoying the privilege of the presidency while ignoring the responsibility that comes with it!"

404.speaker: Player
404.text: "We didn't write it to get votes from the independents."

408.speaker: Mansoun Leke
408.text: "No. You wrote it for the people of Sordland. Some of them, anyway."

409.speaker: Frens Ricter
409.text: "I blame the President for this result. He and his party's weak attitude towards real change doomed him from the start."
409.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Bribed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Promise_Taurus"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Promise_Seat"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_PFJP_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) == false)

410.speaker: Mansoun Leke
410.text: "I hope you don't ignore Bludish rights as well, Mr. President."

411.speaker: Narrator
411.text: Seeing this, more people started to approach him.

413.speaker: Mansoun Leke
413.text: "I've got to go cast my vote."

414.speaker: Narrator
414.text: He bowed in front of Soll and gave him a military salute.

415.speaker: Frens Ricter
415.text: "The President and the USP got what they deserved! This proposal was doomed from the start."

418.speaker: Lucian Galade
418.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Bribed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Promise_Taurus"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Promise_Seat"] == true) == false

419.speaker: Narrator
419.text: I finally reached Lucian, by now deep in conversation with another member of our party. He excused himself and turned towards me.

420.speaker: Frens Ricter
420.text: "I blame the President for this result. He and his party's weak attitude towards real change doomed him from the start."
420.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Bribed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Promise_Taurus"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Frens_Promise_Seat"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_PFJP_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) == false)

421.speaker: Lucian Galade
421.text: "Sir, did you vote yet? We have to be quick."

423.speaker: Narrator
423.text: The MPs kept shouting in the hall. Among them, I heard Frens Ricter's voice.

424.speaker: Narrator
424.text: I signed my vote and prepared the envelope. Together, Lucian and I walked to the center of the hall to cast our votes. He kept rushing me throughout the process.

428.speaker: Narrator
428.text: Gloria bowed her head slightly in respect as she saw us vote. Lucian pulled on my arm and whispered in my ear.
